usage: The word 獅子 (si1 zi2) is a noun used to refer to the animal lion.
獅子 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence, like 'The lion roars' or 'I saw a lion'.
When talking about a lion, 獅子 is usually singular, but you can add a measure word to specify quantity, like 一隻獅子 (jat1 zek3 si1 zi2) meaning one lion.
獅子 can appear in various sentence structures, including statements, questions, and commands.
In Cantonese, 獅子 often appears together with verbs related to animals, like 去 (heoi3) to go, 見 (gin3) to see, or 飼養 (zi6 joeng5) to feed or raise.
